title: Separate messages, separate decision paths
caption: Goldfish live confirmation and the full-set conflict veto determine safe confirmation. That gate constrains frozen finality choices, whose included fields drive chain-state outcomes. Full-set heads also feed stabilization, whose anchor root constrains the Goldfish head walk.

title: One-slot memory and proposer view merge
caption: Old votes expire as scoring weight, while proposer view merge helps reconcile recent evidence. The ordinary wire cutoff is 75%; it is separate from the 50% confirmation snapshot. Alignment remains conditional on delivery and proposer assumptions.

title: Frozen seats support every ancestor
caption: Sixty frozen seats name C, fifteen name B, and twenty-five name D. Subtree support propagates upward: A=100, B=75, C=60, D=25. The strict majority of 100 reaches C; this is a local snapshot calculation.

title: A large observed majority can miss fast confirmation
caption: The same 380 supporting seats pass the delayed relative-majority threshold among 400 timely seats, but fail the immediate absolute threshold of 384 out of all 512 seats. The delayed rule first runs in the following slot.

title: Recovery uses a live candidate while preserving a record
caption: When recovery changes the live confirmed branch from A to B, the ordinary historical record retains A. Historical persistence is not a safety proof; the code also has a defensive reset for unknown or finalized-conflicting historical roots.

title: Positive selection and a conflict veto answer different questions
caption: In one live view with D=60, G1 selects A with forty votes, yet twenty conflicting B votes veto G0 clearance. Selection and clearance are different predicates; neither arithmetic result establishes cross-node agreement by itself.

title: Safe confirmation walks back past substantial opposition
caption: The live available-confirmed head is C, but thirty of ninety usable full-set heads support X. X vetoes B and C at the one-third boundary; A is compatible with X. With floor F and no other qualifying opposition, the safe-confirmed head is A.

title: TSQ separates frozen positive support from later equivocation evidence
caption: Freeze at 75% of the preceding last slot; pin before the new proposal at 0%; act at 25% of the first slot. Timely dissemination and validation must fit both quarter-slot windows. New relay cannot add a signer missing from F, but equivocation evidence can remove support.

title: Different TSQ locks can lead to the same proposal
caption: X locks B while Y locks A; relaying votes 7–8 does not upgrade Y’s frozen support. A timely eligible P built on B can align their heads despite different locks, provided the live-state and confirmed-prefix proposal guards pass.

title: Target support is a subset of distinct height-progress support
caption: A target vote sets both target and progress markers; a timeout sets progress only. With q=43, the three examples justify and advance, advance without justification, or stay at h. The justification branch assumes an ordinary justifiable height; independently available finality is handled first.

title: One-height slack filters eligibility, not vote weight
caption: With frontier twelve, a leaf needs state-height at least eleven. An ancestor remains eligible when it leads to a qualifying leaf, while a branch ending at nine is excluded from ordinary head selection. This filter does not erase its live conflict evidence from G0.

title: Availability can split while full-set progress waits
caption: At 32/32, neither isolated side supplies q=43; at 48/16, the larger side can supply a quorum only with eligible compatible votes and inclusion. Healing exposes a conditional recovery path, not a guarantee: the executable profile still leaves composition and recovery proof obligations open.
